text_block_list.text: Rumble...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaaagh! I'm going to wiiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Graaaah! Don't you dare underestimate
the
Overloooord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Neither of them are letting up the
pressure!
They're locked in a fierce
tussle! A gruesome
battle! And the
winner is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото! The raging storm washes
over the
Overlord's splendor in this
generational
showdown!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Has Doto... always been like this? That
sheer...
power...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: What... is this?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: What am I... feeling right now?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I feel all fuzzy on the inside... and shiny on the outside... and really, really happy!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Is this... the real me? If I keep this up,
just
maybe...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll truly shine!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... haaah ha ha! Frustration eats
at me...
and yet, I feel complete!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Doto. This defeat has taught
me a
valuable lesson. My legend is far
from complete.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I'll get even stronger and shoot for the
throne
beyond the clouds. I'll surpass
you and the
previous generation,
standing supreme as the
ultimate,
miraculous Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll follow your lead—I mean...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best. Let's raise the ante, as
rivals!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: What the heck?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Her lap time! It might not seem like a
huge
difference, but that was faster than
the maximum
possible value for her
stats...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text: I thought your limits were supposed to be absolute. I fought that ceiling for nothing, and then those two just casually shatter it?!
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
I don't get it. The previous generation
have the
higher stats, but...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses must've loaded
the dice in
their favor!
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Looks like the Arima Kinen is going to
be tons of
fun, Grass!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe... after watching this race... that's what comes to mind?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah! I'm more pumped up than
ever. Doto
and Т.М. Опера О are
getting so strong.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That makes me really happy! Just think
how
exciting things will be if everyone
keeps revving it
up!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...You know what? You're right. Sorry,
my
reaction was uncalled for.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I cannot bear to stand here trembling. I
will knock
them down, regally and with
poise.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Traineeeer! Oh, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much! I... I really did it!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: It won't be long before you reach your dream.

text_block_list.text: Yes! I definitely... definitely want to run in the Arima Kinen next! That's where...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'll finally become a racing star! I'll win
against
Opera O, the previous
generation... and I'll shine
more than
anyone else!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото realizes her full potential,
giving up
her attachment to T.M. Opera
O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our next match is the Arima Kinen. Only
victory
will reunite us with the splendor
seen in our
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
